description: This file contains unit tests for Orleans grain reference casting capabilities, including casting between interfaces, upcasting, downcasting, and error handling scenarios.

classes.name: GrainReferenceCastTests
classes.description: Unit test class for testing Orleans grain reference casting and interface compatibility.

methods.name: CastGrainRefCastFromMyType
methods.description: Tests casting a grain reference to its own interface type and verifies type assignability.

methods.name: CastGrainRefCastFromMyTypePolymorphic
methods.description: Tests casting between multiple interfaces implemented by the same grain, ensuring proper type relationships.

methods.name: CastMultifacetRWReference
methods.description: Tests casting between related interfaces (reader/writer) on a multifaceted grain and verifies state consistency.

methods.name: CastFailInternalCastFromBadType
methods.description: Verifies that casting a grain to a non-grain type throws an ArgumentException.

methods.name: CastInternalCastFromMyType
methods.description: Checks that casting a grain to its own interface type is a no-op and returns the same reference.

methods.name: CastInternalCastUpFromChild
methods.description: Tests upcasting from a derived interface to a base interface, ensuring the reference remains the same.

methods.name: CastGrainRefUpCastFromChild
methods.description: Verifies upcasting of grain references from derived to base interfaces using AsReference.

methods.name: FailSideCastAfterResolve
methods.description: Ensures that attempting to cast between sibling interfaces after grain resolution throws InvalidCastException.

methods.name: FailOperationAfterSideCast
methods.description: Checks that calling methods on an invalidly cast grain reference throws InvalidCastException.

methods.name: FailSideCastAfterContinueWith
methods.description: Validates that invalid casts in async continuation chains fail as expected, while valid interface calls succeed.

methods.name: CastGrainRefUpCastFromGrandchild
methods.description: Tests upcasting from a grandchild interface to parent and grandparent interfaces, ensuring type correctness.

methods.name: CastGrainRefUpCastFromDerivedDerivedChild
methods.description: Checks casting from a deeply nested derived interface to its ancestors.

methods.name: CastAsyncGrainRefCastFromSelf
methods.description: Verifies that method calls on a self-cast grain reference work correctly.

methods.name: CastCallMethodInheritedFromBaseClass
methods.description: Tests that methods inherited from base interfaces are accessible after casting.
